title: Shaker / Refining
blurb: Steam pitch starts with sifting value from sand — refining wet sand is the early gold loop described on the store page.

title: Conveyors & Launchers
blurb: Logistics buildings move materials horizontally and vertically so factories stop relying on pure shovel labor.

title: Filters
blurb: Separate material flows so slag, ore, and sand do not clog the same belt — a common early bottleneck players report.

title: Fluids & Pipes
blurb: Water and heat interact with pixel materials; pipes and pumps show up as you expand beyond dry digging.

title: Drones & Deep Tech
blurb: Steam EA roadmap calls out more buildings, resources, production chains, quests, and technologies deeper into the planet.
